connections.title: Data exchange
connections.description: Reports to DUO ROD and the Verzuimloket, OSO transfer files and SWV hand-offs, carried by integriq once learniq's gate allows them.

connections.title: Timetable import
connections.description: Lessons from Zermelo, Untis or Xedule.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Learniq has not reported yet whether planninq is installed. It reports once a day, and when you save the admin settings. Integriq delivers the timetable to planninq, and learniq reads the lessons from there.

connections.title: LTI tools
connections.description: Opening an external learning tool from a course, and pulling its grades back.
connections.unavailableMessage: A launch calls api/lti/deployments/[id]/launch on integriq. Integriq has no such endpoint, so no tool opens. Grades only come back from a tool that opened.

connections.title: EUDI wallet
connections.description: Offering an issued credential to a learner's EUDI wallet, and revoking that offer.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: No integriq API token is set, so no credential reaches a wallet. Set it with occ config:app:set learniq openconnector_api_token.

connections.title: Payments through shillinq
connections.description: Raising a fee's contributions in shillinq, and granting an entitlement once shillinq reports the payment settled.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: No shillinq administration is set, so learniq cannot raise a fee's contributions. Set it with occ config:app:set learniq shillinq_administration_id.

connections.title: SBB leerbedrijf check
connections.description: Checking that the employer of a work placement is an erkend leerbedrijf in the SBB register.
connections.unavailableMessage: No verification provider ships in learniq or integriq. A work placement cannot confirm its leerbedrijf until one does.

connections.title: Proctoring
connections.description: Online supervision of an exam by an outside proctoring service.
connections.unavailableMessage: Learniq defines the provider interface only. No provider ships, and nothing calls it.

connections.title: Plagiarism check
connections.description: Checking a submitted assignment with an outside plagiarism service.
connections.unavailableMessage: Learniq defines the provider interface only. No provider ships, and nothing calls it.
